verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS automation platform with a CLI and SDK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out, a telemetry setting or a usage-tracking control. The SOC 2 and governance controls cited are adjacent security features, not telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
